<style>
:root{--navy:#102d48;--navy2:#183e5e;--gold:#d7b15b;--ink:#1d2a36;--muted:#667788;--paper:#f4f7fa;--white:#fff;--line:#dce4eb;--shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(16,45,72,.10)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,"Noto Sans Lao","Phetsarath OT",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;line-height:1.6}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.wrap{width:min(1180px,92%);margin:auto}
.topline{background:#0a2034;color:#dbe6ef;font-size:.82rem}.topline .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}

.brand strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.23rem;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.5px}.brand small{display:block;color:#687989;font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.4px;margin-top:4px}

.hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(7,29,48,.94),rgba(13,47,73,.78) 52%,rgba(13,47,73,.18)),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center;min-height:510px;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0b263f55,transparent 45%)}
.heroContent{padding:76px 0 84px;max-width:730px}.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:800;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--gold)}.eyebrow:before{content:"";width:32px;height:2px;background:var(--gold)}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5vw,4.35rem);line-height:1.13;margin:18px 0 20px;letter-spacing:-1.2px}.hero p{max-width:600px;color:#e2ebf2;font-size:1.07rem;margin:0 0 28px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 19px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:750;border:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s}.btnGold{background:var(--gold);color:#132c40}.btnGold:hover{background:#e7c879;transform:translateY(-1px)}.btnGhost{border-color:#ffffff8a;color:#fff;background:#ffffff0c}.btnGhost:hover{background:#ffffff20}
.heroNote{position:absolute;right:4%;bottom:24px;color:#e4edf5;font-size:.72rem;opacity:.8}
.quickfacts{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.fact{padding:24px 20px;border-right:1px solid #ffffff20;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.fact:last-child{border:0}.factIcon{width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid #d7b15b8c;color:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;font-size:1.15rem}.fact b{display:block;font-size:.95rem}.fact span{font-size:.78rem;color:#bdcbd8}
section{padding:78px 0}.sectionHead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:25px;margin-bottom:30px}.sectionHead h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3vw,2.55rem);color:var(--navy);margin:8px 0 0;line-height:1.2}.sectionHead p{color:var(--muted);max-width:480px;margin:0}.kicker{font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:1.8px;font-weight:850;color:#a17c2b;text-transform:uppercase}
.aboutGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:55px;align-items:center}.aboutImage{min-height:390px;position:relative;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#102d4800,#102d4860),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover}.imageLabel{position:absolute;left:20px;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:#102d48e8;color:#fff;padding:19px;border-left:4px solid var(--gold);border-radius:5px}.imageLabel b{display:block;font-size:1.15rem}.imageLabel span{color:#d6e2ed;font-size:.83rem}
.aboutText h3{font-size:1.65rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--navy);margin:10px 0 15px}.aboutText p{color:var(--muted)}.checklist{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:22px 0 28px;display:grid;gap:12px}.checklist li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:start}.check{color:#a17c2b;font-weight:900}
.services{background:var(--paper)}.serviceGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:17px}.serviceCard{padding:24px 21px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;transition:.2s}.serviceCard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:#d5bc7e}.serviceIcon{width:50px;height:50px;background:#edf3f7;color:var(--navy);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:20px}.serviceCard h3{color:var(--navy);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 9px}.serviceCard p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin:0}
.projectsGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}.project{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:.2s}.project:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.projectImg{height:205px;position:relative;background:#dbe5ed center/cover}.projectImg:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:45% 0 0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#0c2945a8)}.projectTag{position:absolute;z-index:1;top:14px;left:14px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:5px}.projectBody{padding:21px}.projectBody h3{font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1.35;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 10px}.projectMeta{font-size:.83rem;color:var(--muted);display:grid;gap:6px}.projectMeta span{display:flex;gap:8px}.projectFoot{margin-top:17px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:#967126;font-size:.83rem;font-weight:800}
.history{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.history .sectionHead h2{color:#fff}.history .sectionHead p{color:#c4d1dd}.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;margin-top:35px}.timeItem{border-top:2px solid #d7b15b7d;padding:22px 20px 0 0;position:relative}.timeItem:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-7px;left:0;width:12px;height:12px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #d7b15b22}.timeItem b{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:8px}.timeItem h3{font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 8px}.timeItem p{font-size:.85rem;color:#c3d2df;margin:0;max-width:235px}
.newsGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}.newsCard{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden}.newsImg{height:165px;background:#dbe5ed center/cover}.newsBody{padding:19px}.newsBody small{color:#987328;font-weight:800}.newsBody h3{font-size:1.02rem;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.4;margin:9px 0}.newsBody p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.cta{padding:0 0 78px}.ctaBox{padding:35px 40px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#173f60,#102d48);color:white;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px}.ctaBox h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.7rem}.ctaBox p{margin:0;color:#cbd8e3}
footer{background:#091f32;color:#c5d2de;padding:50px 0 0}.footerGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:35px;padding-bottom:35px}.footerBrand .brand strong{color:white}.footerBrand .brand small{color:#b5c4d2}.footerBrand p{font-size:.87rem;max-width:300px;color:#aebfcd}.footerCol h3{font-size:.95rem;color:#fff;margin:0 0 15px}.footerCol a,.footerCol p{display:block;font-size:.85rem;color:#b4c3d0;margin:9px 0}.footerCol a:hover{color:var(--gold)}.copyright{border-top:1px solid #ffffff1a;padding:17px 0;font-size:.78rem;color:#8fa3b5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.notice{background:#fff8e8;color:#745719;border-bottom:1px solid #ecdcae;padding:9px 0;font-size:.8rem}.notice .wrap{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:1050px){nav{gap:13px;font-size:.83rem}.brand{min-width:210px}.brand small{font-size:.56rem}.serviceGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:820px){.menuBtn{display:block}nav{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:86px;background:white;padding:10px 4% 20px;box-shadow:0 12px 15px #102d4814;align-items:stretch;gap:0;flex-direction:column}nav.open{display:flex}nav a{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.nav{min-height:78px}.brand{min-width:0}.brand strong{font-size:1.1rem}.brand small{max-width:200px}.facts{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.fact:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.fact:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff20}.aboutGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}.aboutImage{min-height:330px}.projectsGrid,.newsGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.timeline{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:28px}.footerGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.hero{min-height:480px}}

.logo{width:62px;height:62px;border:0;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#fff}.logo:after{display:none}.hero{background-position:right center!important}:root{--heroimg:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');--navy:#0b2a55;--navy2:#123a73;--gold:#1f6feb;--blue2:#4a90ff;--sky:#eef5ff;--line:#dfe9f7;--muted:#5d6f89;--shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(20,80,180,.12)}
body{font-family:Inter,"Noto Sans Lao","Phetsarath OT",system-ui,sans-serif;background:#fff;letter-spacing:0}
.topline{background:var(--sky);color:#3a5a8c;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.toplinks a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
header{background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}

.notice{background:#eaf2ff;color:#2a4d85;border-bottom:1px solid #cfe0fb}
.btn{border-radius:999px;padding:13px 24px}.btnGold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2f80ff,#1553c9);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px #1f6feb40}.btnGold:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4a90ff,#1f6feb);transform:translateY(-2px)}.btnGhost{border-color:#b9d1f7;color:var(--navy);background:#fff}.btnGhost:hover{background:var(--sky)}

.heroContent{max-width:600px}.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);background:#e4efff;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:999px}.eyebrow:before{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
h1{line-height:1.28;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.4vw,3.6rem);letter-spacing:-.5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b2a55,#1f6feb);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p{color:var(--muted)}.heroNote{right:7%;bottom:64px;background:#fff;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px #0b3a8a30;opacity:1}
.quickfacts{background:transparent;margin-top:-48px;position:relative;z-index:2}.facts{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.fact{border-right:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--navy)}.fact span{color:var(--muted)}.factIcon{border:0;background:#eaf2ff;color:var(--gold);border-radius:14px}.factIcon svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.kicker{color:var(--gold)}.check{color:var(--gold)}.aboutImage{border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.imageLabel{background:#ffffffee;color:var(--navy);border-left:4px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px}.imageLabel span{color:var(--muted)}
.services{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7faff,#eaf2ff)}.serviceCard{border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #e1ecfb;padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:0 6px 20px #1f6feb0d}.serviceCard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:#9bc2ff}
.serviceIcon{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4a90ff,#1553c9);box-shadow:0 10px 22px #1f6feb40;margin-bottom:22px}.serviceIcon svg{width:27px;height:27px;fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.serviceCard h3{font-size:1.1rem}.project,.newsCard{border-radius:20px;border-color:var(--line)}.projectFoot{color:var(--gold)}.newsBody small{color:var(--gold)}
.history{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b3a8a,#1f6feb)}.timeItem{border-top-color:#ffffff60}.timeItem:before{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #ffffff30}.timeItem b{color:#bcd9ff}.history .sectionHead p,.timeItem p{color:#dbe9ff}.history .kicker{color:#bcd9ff}

#splash{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#fff;z-index:300;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:14px;transition:opacity .6s,visibility .6s}#splash.out{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}.spl{position:relative;width:min(300px,70vw);aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center}.spl img{width:46%;height:46%;border-radius:50%;animation:spp 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #1f6feb33;background:#fff;object-fit:cover}.sw{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;animation:spn 6s linear infinite}@keyframes spn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes spp{50%{transform:scale(1.07)}}#splt{font-weight:700;color:#0b2a55}.spb{display:block;width:180px;height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:#e4efff;overflow:hidden}.spb.go:after{content:"";display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4a90ff,#1f6feb);animation:spl 1.5s ease-out forwards}@keyframes spl{to{width:100%}}

#news .newsBody:after{content:"ອ່ານຕໍ່ →";margin-top:auto;padding-top:6px;color:#1f6feb;font-weight:800;font-size:.92rem}
html[lang=en] #news .newsBody:after{content:"Read more →"}
#news .nslide .ncap h3{font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.6vw,1.8rem);line-height:1.4}
#mdl .mbox{max-width:760px;border-radius:26px}
#mdl .mtxt{padding:28px 32px 34px}
#mdl .mtxt small{display:inline-block;background:#eaf2ff;color:#1553c9;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700}
#mdl .mtxt h3{font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.45;color:#0b2a55;margin:12px 0 14px}
#mdl .mtxt p{font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.95;color:#2b3b52}
#mdl .mimg{height:300px;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
@media(max-width:560px){#mdl .mtxt{padding:20px 20px 26px}#mdl .mtxt p{font-size:1.02rem}}

/* ===== Admin: clearer & more modern ===== */
#adm{font-size:1rem}
#adm .aside{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#081c3d,#0f3a85)}
#adm .anav button{padding:13px 14px;font-size:.98rem;border-radius:14px}
#adm .anav button.on{background:#fff;color:#0f3a85}
#adm .atop{padding:18px 32px}
#adm .atop h2{font-size:1.4rem}
#adm .abtn{padding:11px 20px;font-size:.95rem}
#adm .abtn.g{box-shadow:0 8px 20px #1f6feb40}
#adm .abody{max-width:1180px;padding:26px 32px 100px}
#adm .acard{border-radius:20px;padding:22px;gap:14px;transition:.2s;position:relative}
#adm .acard:hover{border-color:#9bc2ff;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #1f6feb1a}
#adm .acard label{font-size:.82rem;color:#3a5a8c;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;display:block}
#adm .ai,#adm textarea,#adm select{font-size:1rem;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px}
#adm textarea{min-height:76px;line-height:1.6}
#adm .arow{gap:14px}
#adm .athumb{height:110px;width:190px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #dbe6f6}
#adm .astat b{font-size:2.2rem}
#adm .ahelp{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eaf2ff,#f6faff);border:1px solid #cfe0fb;border-left:5px solid #1f6feb;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 20px;color:#27466f;line-height:1.75;font-size:.98rem}
#adm .ahelp b{color:#0b2a55}
#adm .atop p:not(:empty){background:#fff4e0;color:#b25e00;display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:860px){#adm .atop{padding:12px 16px}#adm .abody{padding:16px 14px 90px}#adm .arow{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.facts{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr))!important}
#adm .abtn[data-act=dup]{background:#eaf2ff;color:#1553c9}
</style>
</head>

<section class="hero" id="home"><div class="wrap"><div class="heroContent"><span class="eyebrow" data-i18n="heroEyebrow">POWERING INFRASTRUCTURE</span><h1 data-i18n="heroTitle">ຮ່ວມສ້າງພື້ນຖານໄຟຟ້າ<br>ເພື່ອອະນາຄົດທີ່ຍືນຍົງ</h1><p data-i18n="heroText">ECI ມຸ່ງໝັ້ນພັດທະນາວຽກກໍ່ສ້າງ ແລະ ຕິດຕັ້ງລະບົບໄຟຟ້າ ດ້ວຍຄວາມປອດໄພ, ຄຸນນະພາບ ແລະ ມາດຕະຖານວິຊາຊີບ.</p><div class="actions"><a class="btn btnGold" href="#projects" data-i18n="heroButton1">ເບິ່ງຜົນງານໂຄງການ <span>↗</span></a><a class="btn btnGhost" href="#about" data-i18n="heroButton2">ຮູ້ຈັກ ECI</a></div></div></div><span class="heroNote">ECI · ELECTRICAL INFRASTRUCTURE</span></section>
<div class="quickfacts"><div class="wrap facts"><div class="fact"><span class="factIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M4.9 4.9 7 7M17 17l2.1 2.1M4.9 19.1 7 17M17 7l2.1-2.1"/></svg></span><div><b data-i18n="fact1">ວິສະວະກຳໄຟຟ້າ</b><span data-i18n="fact1s">ຄວາມຊ່ຽວຊານວິຊາຊີບ</span></div></div><div class="fact"><span class="factIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2 4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7z"/></svg></span><div><b data-i18n="fact2">ລະບົບສາຍສົ່ງ</b><span data-i18n="fact2s">ສາຍສົ່ງ ແລະ ສະຖານີໄຟຟ້າ</span></div></div><div class="fact"><span class="factIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3 4 6v6c0 5 3.5 8 8 9 4.5-1 8-4 8-9V6z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg></span><div><b data-i18n="fact3">ຄຸນນະພາບງານ</b><span data-i18n="fact3s">ຄວາມປອດໄພເປັນສຳຄັນ</span></div></div><div class="fact"><span class="factIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 21s7-6 7-12a7 7 0 1 0-14 0c0 6 7 12 7 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9" r="2.5"/></svg></span><div><b data-i18n="fact4">ທົ່ວ ສປປ ລາວ</b><span data-i18n="fact4s">ຮ່ວມພັດທະນາໂຄງສ້າງພື້ນຖານ</span></div></div></div></div>
<section id="about"><div class="wrap aboutGrid"><div class="aboutImage"><div class="imageLabel"><b data-i18n="imageLabelTitle">ພື້ນຖານໄຟຟ້າ ເພື່ອການເຕີບໂຕ</b><span data-i18n="imageLabelText">ຄວາມຊ່ຽວຊານ · ຄວາມປອດໄພ · ຄວາມເຊື່ອໝັ້ນ</span></div></div><div class="aboutText"><span class="kicker" data-i18n="aboutKicker">ABOUT ECI</span><h3 data-i18n="aboutTitle">ພັນທະກິດຂອງພວກເຮົາ</h3><p data-i18n="aboutText">ECI ເປັນອົງກອນດ້ານການກໍ່ສ້າງ ແລະ ຕິດຕັ້ງໄຟຟ້າ. ເວັບໄຊນີ້ຈັດເຮັດເພື່ອນຳສະເໜີປະຫວັດອົງກອນ, ຂອບເຂດທຸລະກິດ, ໂຄງການ ແລະ ຂ່າວສານຢ່າງເປັນລະບົບ.</p><ul class="checklist"><li><span class="check">✓</span><span data-i18n="aboutBullet1">ນຳສະເໜີຂໍ້ມູນອົງກອນຢ່າງຊັດເຈນ</span></li><li><span class="check">✓</span><span data-i18n="aboutBullet2">ລວບລວມຜົນງານ ແລະ ໂຄງການເປັນລຳດັບ</span></li><li><span class="check">✓</span><span data-i18n="aboutBullet3">ຮອງຮັບການສື່ສານພາສາລາວ ແລະ ອັງກິດ</span></li></ul><a class="btn" style="background:var(--navy);color:white" href="#history" data-i18n="aboutButton">ອ່ານປະຫວັດ ECI →</a></div></div></section>
<section class="services" id="services"><div class="wrap"><div class="sectionHead"><div><span class="kicker" data-i18n="servicesKicker">WHAT WE DO</span><h2 data-i18n="servicesTitle">ຂະແໜງທຸລະກິດ</h2></div><p data-i18n="servicesIntro">ພື້ນທີ່ສຳລັບອະທິບາຍຂອບເຂດວຽກງານ ແລະ ບໍລິການຂອງ ECI.</p></div><div class="serviceGrid" id="serviceGrid">
<article class="serviceCard"><div class="serviceIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2 4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7z"/></svg></div><h3 data-i18n="svc1">ສາຍສົ່ງໄຟຟ້າ</h3><p data-i18n="svc1p">ວຽກກໍ່ສ້າງ ແລະ ຕິດຕັ້ງໂຄງສ້າງສາຍສົ່ງຕາມໂຄງການ.</p></article>
<article class="serviceCard"><div class="serviceIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M8 7h8M8 11h8M8 15h5"/></svg></div><h3 data-i18n="svc2">ສະຖານີໄຟຟ້າ</h3><p data-i18n="svc2p">ວຽກຕິດຕັ້ງອຸປະກອນ ແລະ ລະບົບສະຖານີໄຟຟ້າ.</p></article>
<article class="serviceCard"><div class="serviceIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2.5"/><circle cx="5" cy="19" r="2.5"/><circle cx="19" cy="19" r="2.5"/><path d="M12 7.5v4M12 11.5 6.5 17M12 11.5l5.5 5.5"/></svg></div><h3 data-i18n="svc3">ລະບົບຈຳໜ່າຍ</h3><p data-i18n="svc3p">ວຽກຕິດຕັ້ງ ແລະ ປັບປຸງລະບົບຈຳໜ່າຍໄຟຟ້າ.</p></article>
<article class="serviceCard"><div class="serviceIcon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M4.9 4.9 7 7M17 17l2.1 2.1M4.9 19.1 7 17M17 7l2.1-2.1"/></svg></div><h3 data-i18n="svc4">ວຽກວິສະວະກຳ</h3><p data-i18n="svc4p">ວຽກວາງແຜນ, ຕິດຕັ້ງ ແລະ ສະໜັບສະໜູນເຕັກນິກ.</p></article>
</div></div></section>

<section class="history" id="history"><div class="wrap"><div class="sectionHead"><div><span class="kicker" data-i18n="historyKicker">OUR JOURNEY</span><h2 data-i18n="historyTitle">ປະຫວັດ ແລະ ພັດທະນາການ</h2></div><p data-i18n="historyIntro">ຈຸດສຳຄັນໃນປະຫວັດ ECI ຈະຖືກຕື່ມຫຼັງຈາກກວດຢືນຢັນວັນທີ ແລະ ເອກະສານທາງການ.</p></div><div class="timeline" id="timelineBox"><div class="timeItem"><b>01</b><h3 data-i18n="time1">ການກໍ່ຕັ້ງອົງກອນ</h3><p data-i18n="timePending">ລໍຖ້າຢືນຢັນປີ ແລະ ລາຍລະອຽດທາງການ.</p></div><div class="timeItem"><b>02</b><h3 data-i18n="time2">ຂະຫຍາຍຂອບເຂດວຽກ</h3><p data-i18n="timePending">ລໍຖ້າຢືນຢັນປີ ແລະ ລາຍລະອຽດທາງການ.</p></div><div class="timeItem"><b>03</b><h3 data-i18n="time3">ຮ່ວມພັດທະນາໂຄງການ</h3><p data-i18n="timePending">ລໍຖ້າຢືນຢັນປີ ແລະ ລາຍລະອຽດທາງການ.</p></div><div class="timeItem"><b>04</b><h3 data-i18n="time4">ພັດທະນາສູ່ອະນາຄົດ</h3><p data-i18n="timePending">ເພີ່ມຂໍ້ມູນຈາກລາຍງານທາງການ.</p></div></div></div></section>

let language="lo";
function setLanguage(lang){language=lang;document.documentElement.lang=lang;document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(el=>{const key=el.getAttribute("data-i18n");if(translations[lang][key])el.innerHTML=translations[lang][key]});document.getElementById("langToggle").textContent=lang==="lo"?"EN":"ລາວ";}
document.getElementById("langToggle").addEventListener("click",()=>setLanguage(language==="lo"?"en":"lo"));
document.getElementById("menuBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>document.getElementById("mainNav").classList.toggle("open"));
document.querySelectorAll("#mainNav a").forEach(a=>a.addEventListener("click",()=>document.getElementById("mainNav").classList.remove("open")));
document.getElementById("year").textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
var SRC='<!doctype html>\n'+document.documentElement.outerHTML,TAG='<script id="eci-data" type="application/json">',T=translations;
var D={};try{D=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('eci-data').textContent||'{}')}catch(e){}
D.tr=D.tr||{};D.tr.lo=D.tr.lo||{};D.tr.en=D.tr.en||{};D.img=D.img||{};
['lo','en'].forEach(function(l){Object.assign(T[l],D.tr[l])});
var $=function(s,r){return(r||document).querySelector(s)},$$=function(s,r){return[].slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s))};
var bg=function(el){return el.style.backgroundImage.replace(/^url\(["']?|["']?\)$/g,'')};
var both=function(k){return{lo:T.lo[k]||'',en:T.en[k]||''}};
function esc(s){var d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=s==null?'':s;return d.innerHTML.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}
if(!D.projects)D.projects=$$('.project').map(function(el){var s=$$('[data-i18n]',el),g=function(i){return both(s[i].dataset.i18n)};return{img:bg($('.projectImg',el)),tag:g(0),name:g(1),loc:g(2),year:g(3),role:g(4)}});
if(!D.news)D.news=$$('.newsCard').map(function(el){var s=$$('[data-i18n]',el),g=function(i){return both(s[i].dataset.i18n)};return{img:bg($('.newsImg',el)),date:'',tag:g(0),title:g(1),desc:g(2)}});
var IC={bolt:'<path d="M13 2 4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7z"/>',sub:'<rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M8 7h8M8 11h8M8 15h5"/>',net:'<circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2.5"/><circle cx="5" cy="19" r="2.5"/><circle cx="19" cy="19" r="2.5"/><path d="M12 7.5v4M12 11.5 6.5 17M12 11.5l5.5 5.5"/>',gear:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M4.9 4.9 7 7M17 17l2.1 2.1M4.9 19.1 7 17M17 7l2.1-2.1"/>',shield:'<path d="M12 3 4 6v6c0 5 3.5 8 8 9 4.5-1 8-4 8-9V6z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/>',pin:'<path d="M12 21s7-6 7-12a7 7 0 1 0-14 0c0 6 7 12 7 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9" r="2.5"/>'};
var svg=function(k){return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">'+(IC[k]||IC.bolt)+'</svg>'};
if(!D.services)D.services=$$('.serviceCard').map(function(el,i){var s=$$('[data-i18n]',el),g=function(j){return both(s[j].dataset.i18n)};return{ik:['bolt','sub','net','gear'][i]||'bolt',name:g(0),desc:g(1)}});
if(!D.timeline)D.timeline=$$('.timeItem').map(function(el){var s=$$('[data-i18n]',el),g=function(j){return both(s[j].dataset.i18n)};return{title:g(0),desc:g(1)}});
if(!D.sections)D.sections=[];
if(!D.facts)D.facts=$$('.fact').map(function(el){var q=$$('[data-i18n]',el);return{svg:$('.factIcon',el).innerHTML,title:both(q[0].dataset.i18n),sub:both(q[1].dataset.i18n)}});
if(!D.flinks)D.flinks=[];
var L=function(o){return(o&&(o[language]||o.lo))||''};
function render(){
 $('.facts').innerHTML=D.facts.map(function(f){return '<div class="fact"><span class="factIcon">'+(f.ico?esc(f.ico):(f.svg||'⚡'))+'</span><div><b>'+esc(L(f.title))+'</b><span>'+esc(L(f.sub))+'</span></div></div>'}).join('');
 var fcol=$$('.footerCol')[1];if(fcol){$$('.flx',fcol).forEach(function(x){x.remove()});D.flinks.forEach(function(f){var a=document.createElement('a');a.className='flx';var u=/^#/.test(f.url||'')?f.url:safeUrl(f.url||'#');a.href=u;if(/^https?:/.test(u)){a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener'}a.textContent=L(f.name);fcol.appendChild(a)})}
 $('#projectsGrid').innerHTML=D.projects.map(function(p){return '<article class="project"><div class="projectImg" style="background-image:url(\''+p.img+'\')">'+(L(p.tag)?'<span class="projectTag">'+esc(L(p.tag))+'</span>':'')+'</div><div class="projectBody"><h3>'+esc(L(p.name))+'</h3><div class="projectMeta"><span>⌖ '+esc(L(p.loc))+'</span><span>▦ '+esc(L(p.year))+'</span><span>⚙ '+esc(L(p.role))+'</span></div><div class="projectFoot">'+esc(T[language].projectDetails)+'</div></div></article>'}).join('');
 renderNews();
 $('#serviceGrid').innerHTML=D.services.map(function(s){return '<article class="serviceCard"><div class="serviceIcon">'+svg(s.ik)+'</div><h3>'+esc(L(s.name))+'</h3><p>'+esc(L(s.desc))+'</p></article>'}).join('');
 $('#timelineBox').innerHTML=D.timeline.map(function(t,i){return '<div class="timeItem"><b>'+('0'+(i+1)).slice(-2)+'</b><h3>'+esc(L(t.title))+'</h3><p>'+esc(L(t.desc))+'</p></div>'}).join('');
 $$('.csnav').forEach(function(x){x.remove()});
 $('#customSections').innerHTML=D.sections.map(function(s,i){return '<section class="cs'+(i%2?' csBlue':'')+'" id="sec'+i+'"><div class="wrap"><div class="sectionHead"><div><h2>'+esc(L(s.title))+'</h2></div></div><div class="csBody">'+esc(L(s.body)).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+'</div>'+(s.img?'<img class="csImg" src="'+s.img+'" alt="">':'')+'</div></section>'}).join('');
 D.sections.forEach(function(s,i){var a=document.createElement('a');a.className='csnav';a.href='#sec'+i;a.textContent=L(s.menu)||L(s.title);$('#mainNav').appendChild(a)});
 if(D.img.logo)$$('.logo').forEach(function(x){x.src=D.img.logo});
 var h=$('.hero'),a=$('.aboutImage');
 if(D.img.hero)h.style.setProperty('--heroimg','url('+D.img.hero+')');
 if(D.img.about)a.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient(180deg,#102d4800,#102d4860),url('+D.img.about+')';
 $('.notice').style.display=(T[language].prototypeNotice||'').trim()?'':'none';
 applyT();fabUp();renderShop();
 route();
}
D.cfg=Object.assign({wa:'',email:'Ecilaoof@gmail.com'},D.cfg||{});
var TT={navReg:['ແຈ້ງຄວາມຕ້ອງການ','Service Request'],rt:['ແຈ້ງຄວາມຕ້ອງການບໍລິການ','Service Request Form'],rs:['ເລືອກປະເພດບໍລິການ ແລ້ວຕື່ມຂໍ້ມູນ ເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່ ກຕຟ ຈະຕິດຕໍ່ກັບ','Choose a service and fill in your details. ECI staff will contact you.'],f1:['ຕິດຕັ້ງໄຟຟ້າ / ໝໍ້ແປງ','Installation / Transformer'],f2:['ລົດ EV ແລະ ຕູ້ສາກ EV','EV & Charger'],f3:['Solar Rooftop','Solar Rooftop'],svc:['ບໍລິການທີ່ຕ້ອງການ *','Service needed *'],fn:['ຊື່ *','First name *'],ln:['ນາມສະກຸນ *','Last name *'],ph:['ເບີໂທຕິດຕໍ່ *','Phone *'],wa:['WhatsApp (ຖ້າມີ)','WhatsApp (optional)'],vil:['ບ້ານ / ທີ່ຢູ່','Village / address'],dist:['ເມືອງ','District'],prov:['ແຂວງ *','Province *'],map:['ລິ້ງ Google Map','Google Maps link'],geo:['📍 ໃຊ້ຕຳແໜ່ງປັດຈຸບັນ','📍 Use my location'],house:['ປະເພດໄຟໃຊ້ໃນບ້ານ','Household power type'],plug:['ປະເພດຫົວສາກລົດໄຟຟ້າ EV','EV charging connector'],bill:['ເລກບິນ / ເລກມິເຕີໄຟຟ້າ','Electricity bill / meter no.'],note:['ລາຍລະອຽດເພີ່ມເຕີມ','Additional details'],send:['ສ້າງຂໍ້ຄວາມແຈ້ງ ກຕຟ','Prepare request'],err:['ກະລຸນາຕື່ມຊ່ອງທີ່ມີ * ໃຫ້ຄົບ','Please complete the fields marked *'],rd:['ຂໍ້ມູນພ້ອມແລ້ວ — ກົດສົ່ງໃຫ້ ກຕຟ ຜ່ານຊ່ອງທາງລຸ່ມນີ້','Ready — send it to ECI using one of the options below'],em:['ສົ່ງຜ່ານອີເມວ','Send by email'],wb:['ສົ່ງຜ່ານ WhatsApp','Send via WhatsApp'],cp:['ສຳເນົາຂໍ້ຄວາມ','Copy text'],bn:['ກະລຸນາຖ່າຍຮູບບິນໄຟຟ້າ ແລ້ວແນບສົ່ງພ້ອມໃນ WhatsApp ຫຼື ອີເມວ','Please attach a photo of your electricity bill in WhatsApp or email']};
var PROV=[['ນະຄອນຫຼວງວຽງຈັນ','Vientiane Capital'],['ຜົ້ງສາລີ','Phongsaly'],['ຫຼວງນ້ຳທາ','Luang Namtha'],['ອຸດົມໄຊ','Oudomxay'],['ບໍ່ແກ້ວ','Bokeo'],['ຫຼວງພະບາງ','Luang Prabang'],['ຫົວພັນ','Houaphanh'],['ໄຊຍະບູລີ','Xayaboury'],['ຊຽງຂວາງ','Xieng Khouang'],['ວຽງຈັນ','Vientiane Province'],['ບໍລິຄຳໄຊ','Bolikhamxay'],['ຄຳມ່ວນ','Khammouane'],['ສະຫວັນນະເຂດ','Savannakhet'],['ສາລະວັນ','Saravane'],['ເຊກອງ','Sekong'],['ຈຳປາສັກ','Champasak'],['ອັດຕະປື','Attapeu'],['ໄຊສົມບູນ','Xaisomboun']];
var HOUSE=[['ໄຟ 1 ເຟດ (220V)','Single phase (220V)'],['ໄຟ 3 ເຟດ (380V)','Three phase (380V)'],['ບໍ່ແນ່ໃຈ','Not sure']],PLUG=[['Type 1','Type 1'],['Type 2','Type 2'],['CCS2','CCS2'],['CCS1','CCS1'],['CHAdeMO','CHAdeMO'],['GB/T','GB/T'],['ບໍ່ແນ່ໃຈ','Not sure']];
var SV1=[['ຕິດຕັ້ງໄຟຟ້າ','Electrical installation'],['ໝໍ້ແປງໄຟຟ້າ','Transformer']],SV2=[['ລົງທະບຽນຜູ້ນຳໃຊ້ລົດ EV','Register as EV user'],['ຕິດຕັ້ງຕູ້ສາກລົດ EV','EV charger installation']],SV3=[['ຕິດຕັ້ງ Solar Rooftop','Solar Rooftop installation']];
function ip(k,t){return '<div><label data-t="'+k+'"></label><input type="'+(t||'text')+'" data-f="'+k+'"></div>'}
function op(o){return '<option value="'+o[0]+'" data-lo="'+o[0]+'" data-en="'+o[1]+'"></option>'}

.aside{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a2347,#0f3a85);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:20px 14px;gap:14px;overflow:auto}
.abrand{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:6px 8px}.abrand span{font-size:1.6rem;background:#ffffff1f;border-radius:14px;padding:8px}.abrand small{display:block;color:#a9c4f0;font-size:.72rem}
.anav{display:grid;gap:4px}.anav button{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:none;border:0;color:#cfe0ff;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:12px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}.anav button i{font-style:normal;font-size:1.15rem;width:26px;text-align:center}.anav button:hover{background:#ffffff14;color:#fff}.anav button.on{background:#fff;color:#0f3a85;box-shadow:0 6px 16px #0006}
.afoot{margin-top:auto}.afoot button{width:100%;background:#ffffff14;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:11px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.amain{min-width:0}.atop{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:3;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#fffffff2;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);padding:16px 28px;border-bottom:1px solid #dbe6f6}.atop h2{margin:0;font-size:1.25rem;color:#0b2a55}.atop p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:.8rem;color:#e07b00;min-height:1em}.aacts{display:flex;gap:10px}
#adm .abtn{border:1px solid #dbe6f6;background:#fff;color:#0b2a55;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}#adm .abtn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 14px #1f6feb26}#adm .abtn.g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2f80ff,#1553c9);color:#fff;border:0}#adm .abtn.r{background:#fff0ee;color:#c0392b;border-color:#ffd5cf}
#adm .abody{padding:24px 28px 80px;max-width:1100px;display:grid;gap:14px}#adm .acard{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e1ebf8;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 6px 22px #1f6feb0f;display:grid;gap:10px}
.astats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px}.astat{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e1ebf8;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;display:grid;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s;box-shadow:0 6px 22px #1f6feb0f}.astat:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#6ea8ff}.astat i{font-style:normal;font-size:1.6rem}.astat b{font-size:1.9rem;color:#1f6feb}.astat span{color:#5d6f89;font-size:.85rem}.aquick{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#adm .ai,#adm textarea,#adm select{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #d5e2f5;background:#f9fbff;padding:10px 12px}#adm .ai:focus,#adm textarea:focus{outline:2px solid #6ea8ff;border-color:transparent}
#adl form{border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 30px 70px #0007;padding:32px}#adl h3{font-size:1.4rem}#adl .abtn{border-radius:999px;padding:11px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #dbe6f6;background:#fff;font-weight:700}#adl .abtn.g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2f80ff,#1553c9);color:#fff;border:0}
@media(max-width:860px){.alay{grid-template-columns:1fr}.aside{position:static;height:auto;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;padding:10px}.abrand,.afoot{display:none}.anav{display:flex}.anav button{white-space:nowrap}.atop{padding:12px 16px}#adm .abody{padding:16px}}

var tab='dash',dirty=false,ST=null,adm=null,HIDE=/^(fact[1-9]s?|svc[1-4]p?|time[1-4]|timePending|proj[123]|proj[123]loc|news[123]|newsPlaceholder|newsSample|sampleTag|projYear|projRole)$/;
function setP(p,v){var a=p.split('.'),o=D;for(var i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){o=o[a[i]]}o[a[a.length-1]]=v}
function fld(lbl,p,v,ml){return '<div><label>'+lbl+'</label>'+(ml?'<textarea':'<input class="ai"')+' data-p="'+p+'"'+(ml?'>'+esc(v)+'</textarea>':' value="'+esc(v)+'">')+'</div>'}
function pair(lbl,p,o,ml){o=o||{};return '<div class="arow">'+fld(lbl+' (ລາວ)',p+'.lo',o.lo||'',ml)+fld(lbl+' (EN)',p+'.en',o.en||'',ml)+'</div>'}
function up(p,u){return '<div class="arow"><div class="athumb" style="background-image:url(\''+u+'\')"></div><div><label>ປ່ຽນຮູບ</label><input type="file" accept="image/*" data-up="'+p+'"></div></div>'}
function lst(k,fs){return '<button class="abtn g" data-act="add" data-k="'+k+'">➕ ເພີ່ມລາຍການໃໝ່</button>'+D[k].map(function(it,i){return '<div class="acard"><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><b style="margin-right:auto">#'+(i+1)+'</b><button class="abtn" data-act="mv" data-k="'+k+'" data-i="'+i+'" data-d="-1">↑</button><button class="abtn" data-act="mv" data-k="'+k+'" data-i="'+i+'" data-d="1">↓</button><button class="abtn" data-act="dup" data-k="'+k+'" data-i="'+i+'">📄 ສຳເນົາ</button><button class="abtn r" data-act="del" data-k="'+k+'" data-i="'+i+'">🗑️ ລຶບ</button></div>'+(k==='services'||k==='timeline'||k==='facts'||k==='flinks'?'':up(k+'.'+i+'.img',it.img))+fs(k+'.'+i,it)+'</div>'}).join('')}
var NEW={facts:function(){return{ico:'⭐',title:{lo:'ຫົວຂໍ້ໃໝ່',en:'New title'},sub:{lo:'ຄຳອະທິບາຍ',en:'Description'}}},flinks:function(){return{name:{lo:'ລິ້ງໃໝ່',en:'New link'},url:'https://'}},orgs:function(){return{ico:'🏛️',img:'',name:{lo:'ໜ່ວຍງານໃໝ່',en:'New organization'},url:''}},products:function(){return{ico:'📦',name:{lo:'ສິນຄ້າໃໝ່',en:'New product'},desc:{lo:'',en:''},unit:{lo:'',en:''},price:{lo:'',en:''},img:''}},projects:function(){return{img:D.projects[0]?D.projects[0].img:'',tag:{lo:'',en:''},name:{lo:'ໂຄງການໃໝ່',en:'New project'},loc:{lo:'ສະຖານທີ່: ',en:'Location: '},year:{lo:'ປີ: ',en:'Year: '},role:{lo:'ບົດບາດ ECI: ',en:'ECI role: '}}},news:function(){return{cat:'weekly',src:'',ico:'',img:D.news[0]?D.news[0].img:'',date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),tag:{lo:'',en:''},title:{lo:'ຫົວຂໍ້ໃໝ່',en:'New title'},desc:{lo:'',en:''}}},services:function(){return{ik:'bolt',name:{lo:'ບໍລິການໃໝ່',en:'New service'},desc:{lo:'',en:''}}},timeline:function(){return{title:{lo:'ຫົວຂໍ້ໃໝ່',en:'New milestone'},desc:{lo:'',en:''}}},sections:function(){return{menu:{lo:'ເມນູໃໝ່',en:'New'},title:{lo:'ຫົວຂໍ້ໃໝ່',en:'New section'},body:{lo:'',en:''},img:''}}};
function sel(p,v){return '<div><label>ໄອຄອນ</label><select class="ai" data-p="'+p+'">'+Object.keys(IC).map(function(k){return '<option'+(k===v?' selected':'')+'>'+k+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select></div>'}
function catSel(p,v){return '<div><label>ໝວດ</label><select class="ai" data-p="'+p+'">'+[['featured','⭐ ຂ່າວເດັ່ນ (ສະໄລດ໌)'],['weekly','📅 ຂ່າວປະຈຳອາທິດ'],['knowledge','💡 ຄວາມຮູ້ກ່ຽວກັບໄຟຟ້າ']].map(function(o){return '<option value="'+o[0]+'"'+(o[0]===v?' selected':'')+'>'+o[1]+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select></div>'}
var HELP={facts:'<b>ຕົວເລກເດັ່ນ:</b> ກ່ອງຂໍ້ມູນສັ້ນໆໃຕ້ຮູບໜ້າຫຼັກ. ເພີ່ມ, ລຶບ, ສຳເນົາ ແລະ ຍ້າຍລຳດັບໄດ້.',flinks:'<b>ລິ້ງສ່ວນທ້າຍ:</b> ເພີ່ມລິ້ງໃນສ່ວນທ້າຍເວັບ (ເຊັ່ນ Facebook ຫຼື ເອກະສານ).',dash:'<b>ພາບລວມ:</b> ກົດໃສ່ບັອກຕົວເລກເພື່ອໄປແກ້ໄຂໝວດນັ້ນ. ແກ້ໄຂແລ້ວຕ້ອງກົດ <b>💾 ບັນທຶກ</b> ທຸກຄັ້ງ ລູກຄ້າຈຶ່ງຈະເຫັນ.',text:'<b>ຂໍ້ຄວາມ / ເມນູ:</b> ພິມຄົ້ນຫາຂໍ້ຄວາມທີ່ຕ້ອງການແກ້ ແລ້ວແກ້ທັງພາສາລາວ ແລະ English.',services:'<b>ຂະແໜງທຸລະກິດ:</b> ກົດ ➕ ເພື່ອເພີ່ມ, ໃຊ້ ↑ ↓ ປ່ຽນລຳດັບ.',projects:'<b>ໂຄງການ:</b> ໃສ່ຊື່, ສະຖານທີ່, ປີ ແລະ ບົດບາດ ຂອງແຕ່ລະໂຄງການ.',products:'<b>ສິນຄ້າ:</b> ຖ້າບໍ່ໃສ່ລາຄາ ລູກຄ້າຈະເຫັນເປັນ “ສອບຖາມລາຄາ”.',news:'<b>ຂ່າວສານ:</b> ເລືອກໝວດ, ໃສ່ວັນທີ, ຫົວຂໍ້ ແລະ ເນື້ອຫາ. ເນື້ອຫາຍາວໄດ້ — ລູກຄ້າກົດ “ອ່ານຕໍ່” ເພື່ອອ່ານເຕັມ.',orgs:'<b>ໜ່ວຍງານທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ:</b> ໃສ່ຊື່ ແລະ ລິ້ງເວັບໄຊ (ເລີ່ມດ້ວຍ https://).',timeline:'<b>ປະຫວັດ:</b> ເພີ່ມເຫດການສຳຄັນຕາມລຳດັບເວລາ.',sections:'<b>ເພີ່ມໜ້າໃໝ່:</b> ຈະຂຶ້ນເມນູດ້ານເທິງຂອງເວັບອັດຕະໂນມັດ.',img:'<b>ຮູບ / ໂລໂກ້:</b> ເລືອກໄຟລ໌ຮູບເພື່ອປ່ຽນ ແລ້ວກົດ ບັນທຶກ.',cfg:'<b>ຮັບແຈ້ງ:</b> ໃສ່ເບີ WhatsApp ແລະ ອີເມວ ທີ່ຈະຮັບຄຳສັ່ງຊື້ ແລະ ຄຳຮ້ອງຈາກລູກຄ້າ.'};
function body(){return (HELP[tab]?'<div class="ahelp">💡 '+HELP[tab]+'</div>':'')+body0()}
function body0(){
 if(tab==='code')return window.ECICODE?ECICODE.html():'';
 if(tab==='facts')return lst('facts',function(p,it){return fld('ໄອຄອນ emoji (ເວັ້ນວ່າງ = ໃຊ້ໄອຄອນເດີມ)',p+'.ico',it.ico||'')+pair('ຫົວຂໍ້',p+'.title',it.title)+pair('ຄຳອະທິບາຍ',p+'.sub',it.sub)});
 if(tab==='flinks')return lst('flinks',function(p,it){return pair('ຊື່ລິ້ງ',p+'.name',it.name)+fld('ລິ້ງ (https://... ຫຼື #projects)',p+'.url',it.url||'')});
 if(tab==='orgs')return lst('orgs',function(p,it){return fld('ໄອຄອນ emoji (ໃຊ້ເມື່ອບໍ່ມີໂລໂກ້)',p+'.ico',it.ico||'')+pair('ຊື່ໜ່ວຍງານ',p+'.name',it.name)+fld('ລິ້ງເວັບໄຊ (https://...)',p+'.url',it.url||'')});
 if(tab==='dash')return dash();
 if(tab==='products')return lst('products',function(p,it){return fld('ໄອຄອນ (emoji ເຊັ່ນ 🗼)',p+'.ico',it.ico||'')+pair('ຊື່ສິນຄ້າ',p+'.name',it.name)+pair('ລາຍລະອຽດ',p+'.desc',it.desc,1)+pair('ລາຄາ (ເວັ້ນວ່າງ = ສອບຖາມລາຄາ)',p+'.price',it.price)+pair('ຫົວໜ່ວຍ (ເຊັ່ນ ຕົ້ນ)',p+'.unit',it.unit)});
 if(tab==='cfg')return '<div class="acard"><b>ຊ່ອງທາງຮັບແຈ້ງຄວາມຕ້ອງການຈາກລູກຄ້າ</b><span>ເມື່ອລູກຄ້າຕື່ມແບບຟອມ ຂໍ້ຄວາມຈະຖືກສົ່ງໄປຫາ WhatsApp ແລະ ອີເມວຂ້າງລຸ່ມນີ້. ໃສ່ເບີ WhatsApp ພ້ອມລະຫັດປະເທດ ບໍ່ຕ້ອງມີ + ເຊັ່ນ 85620xxxxxxxx</span>'+fld('ເບີ WhatsApp ຮັບແຈ້ງ','cfg.wa',D.cfg.wa)+fld('ອີເມວຮັບແຈ້ງ','cfg.email',D.cfg.email)+fld('Webhook URL (Google Apps Script) — ໃຊ້ໄດ້ເມື່ອເອົາເວັບໄປຢູ່ໂຮສຂອງ ກຕຟ','cfg.hook',D.cfg.hook||'')+'</div>';
 if(tab==='services')return lst('services',function(p,it){return sel(p+'.ik',it.ik)+pair('ຊື່',p+'.name',it.name)+pair('ລາຍລະອຽດ',p+'.desc',it.desc,1)});
 if(tab==='timeline')return lst('timeline',function(p,it){return pair('ຫົວຂໍ້',p+'.title',it.title)+pair('ລາຍລະອຽດ',p+'.desc',it.desc,1)});
 if(tab==='sections')return '<div class="acard">ເພີ່ມໜ້າ/ຫົວຂໍ້ໃໝ່ ຈະຂຶ້ນເປັນສ່ວນໃໝ່ໃນເວັບ ແລະ ມີລິ້ງໃນເມນູດ້ານເທິງອັດຕະໂນມັດ.</div>'+lst('sections',function(p,it){return pair('ຊື່ເມນູ',p+'.menu',it.menu)+pair('ຫົວຂໍ້',p+'.title',it.title)+pair('ເນື້ອຫາ (ຂຽນໄດ້ຫຼາຍແຖວ)',p+'.body',it.body,1)});
 if(tab==='text')return '<input class="ai" id="aq" placeholder="ຄົ້ນຫາ ຂໍ້ຄວາມ / ລະຫັດ...">'+Object.keys(T.lo).filter(function(k){return!HIDE.test(k)}).map(function(k){return '<div class="acard" data-k="'+esc(k)+'"><label>'+esc(k)+'</label><div class="arow">'+fld('ລາວ','tr.lo.'+k,T.lo[k]||'',1)+fld('English','tr.en.'+k,T.en[k]||'',1)+'</div></div>'}).join('');
 if(tab==='projects')return lst('projects',function(p,it){return pair('ຊື່ໂຄງການ',p+'.name',it.name)+pair('ສະຖານທີ່',p+'.loc',it.loc)+pair('ປີ',p+'.year',it.year)+pair('ບົດບາດ',p+'.role',it.role)+pair('ປ້າຍ',p+'.tag',it.tag)});

function panel(){var t=TABS.filter(function(x){return x[0]===tab})[0]||TABS[0];adm.innerHTML='<div class="alay"><aside class="aside"><div class="abrand"><span>⚡</span><div><b>ECI Admin</b><small>ລະບົບຫຼັງບ້ານ</small></div></div><nav class="anav">'+TABS.map(function(x){return '<button data-tab="'+x[0]+'" class="'+(tab===x[0]?'on':'')+'"><i>'+x[1]+'</i><span>'+x[2]+'</span></button>'}).join('')+'</nav><div class="afoot"><button data-act="out">🚪 ອອກຈາກລະບົບ</button></div></aside><main class="amain"><div class="atop"><div><h2>'+t[1]+' '+t[2]+'</h2><p id="amsg">'+(dirty?'● ມີການປ່ຽນແປງທີ່ຍັງບໍ່ໄດ້ບັນທຶກ':'')+'</p></div><div class="aacts"><button class="abtn" data-act="close">👁️ ເບິ່ງເວັບ</button><button class="abtn g" data-act="save">💾 ບັນທຶກ & ເຜີຍແຜ່</button></div></div><div class="abody">'+body()+'</div></main></div>'}
function msg(t){var m=$('#amsg');if(m)m.textContent=t;if(t&&t.indexOf('ມີການ')<0&&t.indexOf('ກຳລັງ')<0)toast(t)}

 adm.addEventListener('input',function(e){var t=e.target;if(t.id==='aq'){var q=t.value.toLowerCase();$$('.acard[data-k]',adm).forEach(function(c){c.style.display=c.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1||c.dataset.k.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1||[].some.call(c.querySelectorAll('textarea'),function(x){return x.value.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1})?'':'none'});return}
  var p=t.dataset.p;if(!p)return;setP(p,t.value);var m=p.match(/^tr\.(lo|en)\.(.+)$/);if(m)T[m[1]][m[2]]=t.value;dirty=true;setLanguage(language);msg('ມີການປ່ຽນແປງທີ່ຍັງບໍ່ໄດ້ບັນທຶກ')});
 adm.addEventListener('change',function(e){var t=e.target;if(!t.dataset.up||!t.files[0])return;var p=t.dataset.up;shrink(t.files[0],p==='img.hero'?1600:p==='img.logo'?300:900,function(u){setP(p,u);dirty=true;setLanguage(language);panel()})});
 adm.addEventListener('click',function(e){var b=e.target.closest('[data-act],[data-tab]');if(!b)return;if(b.dataset.tab){tab=b.dataset.tab;panel();return}
  var a=b.dataset.act,k=b.dataset.k,i=+b.dataset.i;

  if(a==='mv'){var j=i+ +b.dataset.d;if(j>=0&&j<D[k].length){var x=D[k][i];D[k][i]=D[k][j];D[k][j]=x;dirty=true;render();panel()}}
  if(a==='dup'){D[k].splice(i+1,0,JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(D[k][i])));dirty=true;render();panel()}
  if(a==='close'){adm.remove();adm=null}
  if(a==='out'){try{delete sessionStorage.eciadm}catch(e){}adm.remove();adm=null}
  if(a==='save')save()})}
function shrink(f,m,cb){var r=new FileReader();r.onload=function(){var im=new Image();im.onload=function(){var s=Math.min(1,m/Math.max(im.width,im.height)),c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=im.width*s;c.height=im.height*s;c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.8))};im.src=r.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)}
async function save(){
 try{var art=await claude.use('artifact');if(!art){msg('ບັນທຶກບໍ່ໄດ້: ຕ້ອງເປີດໃນ claude.ai ດ້ວຍບັນຊີເຈົ້າຂອງເວັບ');return}
  msg('ກຳລັງບັນທຶກ...');var src=null;try{var r=await fetch(location.href.split('#')[0]);if(r.ok)src=await r.text()}catch(e){}

 catch(e){msg(e&&(e.code==='not_writer'||e.code==='not_granted')?'ບັນຊີນີ້ບໍ່ມີສິດແກ້ໄຂໜ້າເວັບ (ຕ້ອງແມ່ນເຈົ້າຂອງ)':'ບັນທຶກບໍ່ສຳເລັດ: '+(e&&e.code||e))}}

try{if(sessionStorage.eciadm)open()}catch(e){}
$('#spl').src=$('.logo').src;setTimeout(function(){$('#splash').classList.add('out')},1500);

"\\n";\nforeach ($projects as $i => $p) {\n    echo ($i + 1) . ". " . $p . "\\n";\n}\n?>\n'},

" + projects.get(i));\n        }\n    }\n}\n'},
{n:'app.js',c:'// JavaScript ຣັນໄດ້ໃນນີ້ເລີຍ\nconst items = ["PHP", "Java", "JavaScript"];\nitems.forEach((x, i) => console.log((i + 1) + ". " + x));\n'},
{n:'page.html',c:'<!doctype html>\n<html lang="lo">\n<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>ECI</title>\n<style>body{font-family:sans-serif;padding:24px}h1{color:#0c2945}</style></head>\n<body>\n  <h1>ສະບາຍດີ ECI</h1>\n  <p>ໜ້ານີ້ພຣີວິວໄດ້ດ້ວຍປຸ່ມ ▶</p>\n</body>\n</html>\n'}
];

try{var s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null');if(s&&s.files&&s.files.length){files=s.files;cur=Math.min(s.cur||0,files.length-1);open_=(s.open||[]).filter(function(i){return i<files.length});if(!open_.length)open_=[cur]}}catch(e){}
if(!files)files=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(STARTER));
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify({files:files,cur:cur,open:open_}))}catch(e){}}
var KW={
php:'abstract and array as break callable case catch class clone const continue declare default do echo else elseif empty enddeclare endfor endforeach endif endswitch endwhile extends final finally fn for foreach function global if implements include include_once instanceof insteadof interface isset list match namespace new or print private protected public readonly require require_once return static switch throw trait try unset use var while xor yield true false null self parent int string float bool void mixed',
java:'abstract assert boolean break byte case catch char class const continue default do double else enum extends final finally float for goto if implements import instanceof int interface long native new package private protected public return short static strictfp super switch synchronized this throw throws transient try void volatile while var record true false null',
js:'async await break case catch class const continue debugger default delete do else export extends finally for function if import in instanceof let new of return static super switch this throw try typeof var void while yield true false null undefined',
css:'',html:'',json:'true false null',txt:''};
var KS={};Object.keys(KW).forEach(function(k){var o={};KW[k].split(' ').forEach(function(w){if(w)o[w]=1});KS[k]=o});
function lang(n){var e=(n.split('.').pop()||'').toLowerCase();return{php:'php',java:'java',js:'js',mjs:'js',css:'css',html:'html',htm:'html',json:'json'}[e]||'txt'}
function E(s){return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')}
function hl(code,lg){
 if(lg==='txt')return E(code);
 var parts=[];
 if(lg==='html')parts.push(['c',/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/],['p',/<\?php|<\?=|\?>/],['t',/<\/?[A-Za-z][\w:-]*/],['t',/\/?>/],['s',/"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/],['a',/[\w:-]+(?==)/]);
 else if(lg==='css')parts.push(['c',/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//],['s',/"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/],['n',/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:px|em|rem|%|vh|vw|s)?\b/],['a',/[\w-]+(?=\s*:)/],['t',/[.#][\w-]+/]);
 else{
  var cm=lg==='php'?/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*|#[^\n]*/:/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*/;
  parts.push(['c',cm]);
  if(lg==='php')parts.push(['p',/<\?php|<\?=|\?>/],['v',/\$[A-Za-z_]\w*/]);
  parts.push(['s',lg==='js'?/"(?:\\.|[^"\\\n])*"|'(?:\\.|[^'\\\n])*'|`(?:\\.|[^`\\])*`/:/"(?:\\.|[^"\\\n])*"|'(?:\\.|[^'\\\n])*'/],['n',/\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b/]);
  if(lg==='java')parts.push(['a',/@[A-Za-z_]\w*/]);
  parts.push(['w',/[A-Za-z_]\w*/]);
 }
 var re=new RegExp(parts.map(function(p){return '('+p[1].source+')'}).join('|'),'g'),out='',last=0,m;
 while((m=re.exec(code))){
  if(m[0]===''){re.lastIndex++;continue}
  out+=E(code.slice(last,m.index));
  var gi=1;while(gi<=parts.length&&m[gi]===undefined)gi++;
  var k=parts[gi-1][0],t=m[0],cls=k;
  if(k==='w'){var nx=code.slice(m.index+t.length).match(/^\s*\(/);cls=KS[lg][t]?'k':(nx?'f':(/^[A-Z]/.test(t)?'y':''))}
  out+=cls?'<span class="cx-'+cls+'">'+E(t)+'</span>':E(t);
  last=m.index+t.length;
 }
 return out+E(code.slice(last));
}

+'#cx .cxbox{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0}'
+'#cx .cxhl,#cx .cxta{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;padding:10px;border:0;box-sizing:border-box;font:inherit;white-space:pre;tab-size:4;overflow:auto}'
+'#cx .cxhl{pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;color:#d4d4d4;background:transparent}'
+'#cx .cxta{background:transparent;color:transparent;caret-color:#fff;resize:none;outline:0}#cx .cxta::selection{background:#264f78;color:transparent}'
+'#cx .cxout{flex:none;max-height:34%;overflow:auto;border-top:1px solid #3c3c3c;background:#181818;display:none}'
+'#cx .cxout pre{margin:0;padding:10px 12px;font:12.5px/1.5 Consolas,Menlo,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;color:#cfcfcf}#cx .cxout iframe{width:100%;height:220px;border:0;background:#fff;display:block}'
+'#cx .cxstat{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:var(--ac);color:#fff;font-size:.72rem;padding:4px 12px}'
+'#cx .cx-c{color:#6a9955}#cx .cx-s{color:#ce9178}#cx .cx-n{color:#b5cea8}#cx .cx-k{color:#569cd6}#cx .cx-f{color:#dcdcaa}#cx .cx-y{color:#4ec9b0}#cx .cx-v{color:#9cdcfe}#cx .cx-p{color:#c586c0}#cx .cx-t{color:#569cd6}#cx .cx-a{color:#9cdcfe}'
+'@media(max-width:700px){#cx .cxside{width:120px}}';
var st=document.createElement('style');st.textContent=CSS;document.head.appendChild(st);
function init(el){
 var $=function(s){return el.querySelector(s)};
 var ta=$('.cxta'),pre=$('.cxhl'),gut=$('.cxgut'),out=$('.cxout'),stat=$('.cxstat span:first-child'),pos=$('.cxstat span:last-child');
 function ico(n){return{php:'🐘',java:'☕',js:'🟨',css:'🎨',html:'🌐',json:'📋'}[lang(n)]||'📄'}
 function side(){$('.cxside').innerHTML='<h4>EXPLORER · ECI-CODE</h4>'+files.map(function(f,i){return '<div class="cxf'+(i===cur?' on':'')+'" data-f="'+i+'">'+ico(f.n)+' '+E(f.n)+'</div>'}).join('')}
 function tabs(){$('.cxtabs').innerHTML=open_.map(function(i){return '<div class="cxt'+(i===cur?' on':'')+'" data-f="'+i+'">'+ico(files[i].n)+' '+E(files[i].n)+' <b data-x="'+i+'">✕</b></div>'}).join('')}
 function paint(){var c=ta.value,lg=lang(files[cur].n);pre.innerHTML='<code>'+hl(c,lg)+'\n </code>';var n=c.split('\n').length,g='';for(var i=1;i<=n;i++)g+=i+'\n';gut.textContent=g;sync();info()}
 function sync(){pre.scrollTop=ta.scrollTop;pre.scrollLeft=ta.scrollLeft;gut.scrollTop=ta.scrollTop}
 function info(){var v=ta.value.slice(0,ta.selectionStart).split('\n');pos.textContent='Ln '+v.length+', Col '+(v[v.length-1].length+1)+' · UTF-8 · Spaces: 4'}
 function show(i){cur=i;if(open_.indexOf(i)<0)open_.push(i);ta.value=files[i].c;stat.textContent={php:'PHP',java:'Java',js:'JavaScript',css:'CSS',html:'HTML',json:'JSON',txt:'Plain Text'}[lang(files[i].n)]+' · '+files[i].n;side();tabs();paint();out.style.display='none';persist()}
 function tpl(n){var l=lang(n),b=n.replace(/\.[^.]*$/,'');return l==='php'?'<?php\n\n':l==='java'?'public class '+b+' {\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        System.out.println("Hello");\n    }\n}\n':l==='html'?'<!doctype html>\n<html>\n<head><meta charset="utf-8"></head>\n<body>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n':''}
 function run(){
  var f=files[cur],l=lang(f.n);out.style.display='block';
  if(l==='html'){out.innerHTML='<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe>';out.firstChild.srcdoc=f.c}
  else if(l==='js'){out.innerHTML='<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe>';out.firstChild.style.height='150px';
   out.firstChild.srcdoc='<body style="margin:0;background:#181818;color:#cfcfcf;font:12.5px/1.5 Consolas,monospace"><pre id="o" style="margin:0;padding:10px;white-space:pre-wrap"></pre><script>var o=document.getElementById("o");function w(a){o.textContent+=[].map.call(a,function(x){try{return typeof x==="object"?JSON.stringify(x):String(x)}catch(e){return String(x)}}).join(" ")+"\\n"}console.log=function(){w(arguments)};console.error=function(){w(arguments)};try{'+f.c.replace(/<\/script>/gi,'<\\/script>')+'}catch(e){w(["Error: "+e.message])}<\/script></body>'}
  else if(l==='php'){out.innerHTML='<pre>⚠️ PHP ຣັນໃນເບຣົາເຊີບໍ່ໄດ້ (ຕ້ອງມີ PHP ຢູ່ເຄື່ອງ/ເຊີບເວີ).\nວິທີຣັນຢູ່ເຄື່ອງ — ດາວໂຫຼດໄຟລ໌ ແລ້ວພິມໃນ Terminal ຂອງ VS Code:\n\n  php '+E(f.n)+'\n  php -S localhost:8000      (ເປີດເວັບທົດສອບ)\n\nຫຼື ໃຊ້ XAMPP / Laragon ວາງໄຟລ໌ໃນໂຟນເດີ htdocs.</pre>'}
  else if(l==='java'){var b=f.n.replace(/\.[^.]*$/,'');out.innerHTML='<pre>⚠️ Java ຣັນໃນເບຣົາເຊີບໍ່ໄດ້ (ຕ້ອງຕິດຕັ້ງ JDK).\nວິທີຣັນຢູ່ເຄື່ອງ — ດາວໂຫຼດໄຟລ໌ ແລ້ວພິມໃນ Terminal ຂອງ VS Code:\n\n  javac '+E(f.n)+'\n  java '+E(b)+'\n\n(ຊື່ class ຕ້ອງກົງກັບຊື່ໄຟລ໌ ' +E(f.n)+')\nໃນ VS Code ຕິດຕັ້ງ "Extension Pack for Java" ແລະ "PHP Intelephense".</pre>'}
  else out.innerHTML='<pre>ປະເພດໄຟລ໌ນີ້ບໍ່ມີ Preview.</pre>';
 }
 function dl(){var f=files[cur],a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([f.c],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}));a.download=f.n;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href)},2000)}
 ta.addEventListener('input',function(){files[cur].c=ta.value;paint();persist()});
 ta.addEventListener('scroll',sync);['keyup','click'].forEach(function(e){ta.addEventListener(e,info)});
 ta.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key==='s'){e.preventDefault();dl();return}
  var s=ta.selectionStart,en=ta.selectionEnd,v=ta.value;
  if(e.key==='Tab'){e.preventDefault();ta.value=v.slice(0,s)+'    '+v.slice(en);ta.selectionStart=ta.selectionEnd=s+4;ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))}
  else if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();var ls=v.lastIndexOf('\n',s-1)+1,ind=(v.slice(ls,s).match(/^\s*/)||[''])[0],extra=/[{(\[:]\s*$/.test(v.slice(ls,s))?'    ':'';ta.value=v.slice(0,s)+'\n'+ind+extra+v.slice(en);ta.selectionStart=ta.selectionEnd=s+1+ind.length+extra.length;ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))}
  else{var pr={'(':')','[':']','{':'}','"':'"',"'":"'"};if(pr[e.key]&&s===en){e.preventDefault();ta.value=v.slice(0,s)+e.key+pr[e.key]+v.slice(en);ta.selectionStart=ta.selectionEnd=s+1;ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))}}
 });
 el.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var x=e.target.closest('[data-x]');
  if(x){e.stopPropagation();var i=+x.dataset.x;open_=open_.filter(function(k){return k!==i});if(!open_.length)open_=[i];if(cur===i)cur=open_[open_.length-1];show(cur);return}
  var f=e.target.closest('[data-f]');if(f){show(+f.dataset.f);return}
  var a=e.target.closest('[data-cx]');if(!a)return;a=a.dataset.cx;
  if(a==='new'){var n=prompt('ຊື່ໄຟລ໌ (ເຊັ່ນ test.php, Hello.java):','new.php');if(!n)return;n=n.trim().replace(/[\\\/]/g,'');if(!n)return;if(files.some(function(q){return q.n===n})){alert('ມີໄຟລ໌ຊື່ນີ້ແລ້ວ');return}files.push({n:n,c:tpl(n)});show(files.length-1)}
  if(a==='ren'){var r=prompt('ຊື່ໃໝ່:',files[cur].n);if(!r)return;r=r.trim().replace(/[\\\/]/g,'');if(r&&!files.some(function(q,i){return i!==cur&&q.n===r})){files[cur].n=r;show(cur)}}
  if(a==='del'){if(files.length<2){alert('ຕ້ອງເຫຼືອຢ່າງໜ້ອຍ 1 ໄຟລ໌');return}if(!confirm('ລຶບ '+files[cur].n+' ?'))return;var d=cur;files.splice(d,1);open_=open_.filter(function(k){return k!==d}).map(function(k){return k>d?k-1:k});cur=Math.max(0,d-1);if(!open_.length)open_=[cur];show(cur)}
  if(a==='run')run();
  if(a==='dl')dl();
 });
 show(cur);
}
window.ECICODE={html:function(){return '<div id="cx"><div class="cxbar"><button data-cx="new">➕ ໄຟລ໌ໃໝ່</button><button data-cx="run">▶ ຣັນ / Preview</button><button data-cx="dl">⬇️ ດາວໂຫຼດ (Ctrl+S)</button><button data-cx="ren">✏️ ປ່ຽນຊື່</button><button data-cx="del">🗑️ ລຶບ</button></div><div class="cxmain"><aside class="cxside"></aside><section class="cxed"><div class="cxtabs"></div><div class="cxwrap"><div class="cxgut"></div><div class="cxbox"><pre class="cxhl"></pre><textarea class="cxta" spellcheck="false" wrap="off"></textarea></div></div><div class="cxout"></div></section></div><div class="cxstat"><span></span><span></span></div></div><p style="font-size:.78rem;color:#667;margin:8px 2px">💡 ໄຟລ໌ເກັບໄວ້ໃນເບຣົາເຊີເຄື່ອງນີ້ (ບໍ່ຂຶ້ນເວັບສາທາລະນະ). HTML/JavaScript ຣັນ Preview ໄດ້ທັນທີ; PHP ແລະ Java ຕ້ອງດາວໂຫຼດໄປຣັນໃນ VS Code ຢູ່ເຄື່ອງ.</p>'}};
new MutationObserver(function(){var el=document.getElementById('cx');if(el&&!el.dataset.i){el.dataset.i='1';init(el)}}).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();

</script>
</body></html>
